title: Preserve GGUF file when model index deletion fails
goal: Prevent partial deletion from removing a GGUF file when FileBackedLocalModelStorage cannot persist the updated model index.
context: deleteModel currently removes the GGUF file before persisting the index. If index persistence fails, the in-memory index is restored but the large model file is already gone. Persist metadata removal first and restore metadata if file removal itself fails.
forbidden_changes: Do not silently delete a model when index persistence fails.
Do not weaken GGUF validation, file-size checks, or active-model selection checks.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
acceptance_criteria: Index persistence failure leaves the original GGUF file and in-memory descriptor/selection intact.
If file removal fails after metadata persistence, restore the prior index and propagate the failure; report storage corruption if metadata rollback fails.
Regression test forces index persistence failure and confirms the GGUF file, descriptor, and active selection remain.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if model deletion or metadata rollback behavior regresses.
